title: Dashboard Launch Cockpit
description: The dashboard (`bun run dashboard`, `semio …`) is the only developer control plane: no launch.json anywhere, every runnable thing declared next to its owner, configs derived and drift-checked, battle tested across the monorepo.
summary: Round 2 (2026-10-08): all launch.json files dissolved (.vscode/launch.json, .vscode/🧩️launch.seed.jsonc, .claude/launch.json); every capability maps to a dashboard command (r2-slice-m2.md). Entry: `bun run dashboard` (TUI) and `bun run dashboard <verb>` ≡ `semio commands|run|tasks|logs|stop|restart|kill|open|daemon|preferences|catalog`, one stable task handle, no root-script delegation; root package.json = nx/setup/dashboard/dashboard:install; stale installed binary rebuilds automatically. Commands come only from Nx targets, the playground catalog, metadata.semio.dashboard declarations and open tickets' 🎮️commands.json; MCP client files and devcontainer editor settings derived and drift-checked; hooks, dependabot, nextest copies canonicalised; 🚚️migration.json removed. Daemon §3 and TUI §4 complete; Nx graph integrity guarded. Evidence: dashboard lib 206/206, TUI 363/363, battle tests green directly and via Nx (coverage 9/9, CLI journeys 11/11, PTY journeys 9/9, load 4/4+3/3, real-workspace smoke 2/2); real cutover via `bun run dashboard`: 26,564 commands 0 problems, quiz served on 6061 and stopped cleanly. Owner actions: AGENTS.md lines 50–51, stage launch-file deletions, decide gemini --yolo / kiro --trust-all-tools tools and Monorepo.sln. See r2-summary.md.
note: Closed manually on 2026-10-08: repo MCP ticket_reopen returned a malformed result and ticket_close hung twice (1800 s, with and without management).
